title: taraxacum ochrocarpum
intro: Taraxacum ochrocarpum, commonly known as the yellow dandelion or false dandelion, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum ochrocarpum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also contribute to its potential in treating various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disorders.
